items.title: Mrs. Arnold Metoyer Interview, 1960-10-19
items.q: This is a good picture of George Moore right here.

ctx.x: Boy, I see Manette would know some of them.

Well, you said this man here or this man is not Mr. Sheldon? Let me see. That's not Mr. Sheldon? I can't make a moment. Thank you. Well, if it is, I couldn't recognize him. I know him very well. Well, you should be. But I don't think he's on that. No picture Sheldon. Because I was sitting there just trying to see who could be him. If anybody would be him on it, it would be this man, but that's not him. No. I'm almost sure. This is a good picture of George Moore right here. Yes, indeed.
I think we had a picture. I've never seen a picture of George Moore, I don't believe.
